answer: An agent marketplace requires each seller identity to lock 100 onyx tokens for 30 days before bidding. The bonds form a trellis that makes a swarm of hollow identities costly to maintain: creating 1,000 eligible sellers ties up 100,000 tokens for a month. Each bond is forfeited if its seller signs conflicting receipts for the same job, so an attacker pays both the cost of immobilized capital and losses on provable fraud.
